card.name: Is/be after patients, embryos, tumor
card.fires_on: The helping verb "be", "are", "were" or "is" right after a subject such as "Patients may", "embryos" or "tumor". It is strongest in warning statements about risk and in embryo culture descriptions.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and mostly non-English, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push toward word starts like "gen" and "chrom".
card.plain: It fires on the little verb "be" or "are" that comes right before a statement about risk or about what is done to embryos or tumors.
